title: Finite positive constant compact-open components
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $K,C$ abelian sheaves, $\iota:K\to C$ a monomorphism, and $C\simeq\underline{\mathbb Z}$ an isomorphism to the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Assume an epimorphism from a finite coproduct of $j_{U_i!}\underline{\mathbb Z}$, where every $U_i$ is compact open [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. There exist a finite family of compact opens $A_i$, positive natural labels $c_i$, and component maps $f_i:j_{A_i!}\underline{\mathbb Z}\to K$ whose coproduct map is epi. Evaluating $f_i$ on the canonical integer-one section gives a section whose image under $\iota$ followed by the chosen isomorphism is the constant section $c_i$. The family may be empty. Neither compactness of intersections nor a divisor condition is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 0A38, first two proof paragraphs; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A38

proof.text: Evaluate the original component maps on their integer-one sections. View the images in the constant integer sheaf as locally constant integer functions. Compactness makes the image finite; their clopen fibres form a finite partition of each original domain and are compact in X. Restrict the sections to these fibres.

On a fibre with zero value the section is zero by monicity. Delete those fibres and negate both section and component for a negative value. Integer multiplication by a section induces a map from the constant presheaf to the restriction of K. Sheafify this map, apply extension by zero and compose with the restriction counit; its unit image is the chosen section. This constructs positive constant components.

At every point each old domain has exactly one fibre through the point, and its generator is equal up to sign to the corresponding new generator, or is zero. Extension stalks outside the domain vanish. Thus the new map has the same generated subgroup on each stalk as the old epimorphism. Stalkwise surjectivity implies it is epi. Enumerate the finite family by Fin n. If all components vanish, every stalk of K is zero and the map from the empty coproduct is epi.

        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) (A i) le_rfl
